Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Copilot 365 and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may not see options to select GPT models in Microsoft 365 Copilot

User impact: Users may not see options to select GPT models in Copilot.

Current status: We’ve identified a recent change, which intended to filter out model groups based on policy ID, introduced a configuration issue that’s resulting in impact. We’re reviewing options to revert this change to restore access to these impacted models and remediate impact for all users.

Scope of impact: This issue may affect any user attempting to utilize GPT models in Copilot. 

Root cause: A recent change, which was intended to filter out model groups based on policy ID, introduced a configuration issue that’s resulting in impact.

Next update by: Monday, October 19, 2026, at 7:30 PM UTC
